description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for blog or travel posts in the TripTales application, including fields like title, content, images, tags, locations, tips, author, liked count, favorites, and status, along with index configurations.

classes.name: PostSchema
classes.description: Main Mongoose schema defining the structure of the 'Post' documents, including sub-schemas for images and tips.

classes.name: ImageSubSchema
classes.description: Sub-schema for images associated with a post, including URL, public ID, width, and height.

classes.name: TipSubSchema
classes.description: Sub-schema for tips within a post, including text and optional author.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: The Mongoose model for 'Post', exported for database operations.

ctags.name: InferSchemaType
ctags.pattern: /^import mongoose, { Schema, type InferSchemaType, type Model } from "mongoose";$/
